short.lead: This is the build plan for restructure steps 3 to 7, which you chose to build as one feature with one QA page at the end. What each step changes is on the design page, docs/plans/2026-10-21-restructure-steps-3-7.html. A helper agent builds each step, one at a time, in the order below. Each step merges into the branch AjsAgent/issue-281-fix once verify.py passes, and the five steps ship to the main branch together after your QA pass.
short.hint: Tap a step to see what it builds and what it waits on.
items: The five step issues already exist: #341, #349, #343, #344 and #345. The design loop only counts issues created after a design approval, so two new issues hold this feature: a parent issue for steps 3 to 7, and one for the QA page and release.
The five existing step issues close through a sweep page after the merge, citing your QA pass, as restructure step 2's issues do.
Built first, because steps 4 and 7 read the agent name and branch prefix from settings.
The settings script, the refusal until settings are set, the session-start question, and the identity strings read from settings.

Deletes allowed only on the agent's own branches, author and credit line from settings, the Claude credit line removed from the automatic work-in-progress commits, and snapshot branches deleted once merged.
Nothing from you. Depends on step 3.
Sub-features linked to their parent through GitHub's sub-issue link, the check that the decisions-log entry is required before the next stage, and private publishing of every page in cloud sessions.
The rule for asking before skipping a long, paid or unreachable check, the overwrite guard counting an edit that replaces more than half of a file, and the end-of-reply check for an unasked fix.
A helper stops and reports a question only you can answer, a helper's report quotes every failure line, and autosave pushes without force to a fresh snapshot branch.
Nothing from you. Depends on step 4.
One QA page for all five steps
Version 2.74.0, the docs for each part, and one QA page showing each step's checks.
